seo_title: Cloud Migration for SMEs: Eliminate the Physical Server
seo_desc: Does your local server fail and paralyze your clinic or firm? We execute Private Cloud migrations for SMEs: remote access, maximum security, and zero downtime.
author_pitch: As a Cloud Specialist, I find it terrifying that law firms or clinics with dozens of employees depend on a physical server hidden in a closet that shuts down if there is a power outage. That operational risk is unacceptable. I design and execute complete migrations to Private Cloud infrastructures, moving all your local software to a secure cloud accessible from anywhere without your team noticing the change.
title: The danger of the server in the closet: Private Cloud Migration for firms and clinics
body:
Does your firm or clinic come to a complete halt because the physical office server has crashed, overheated, or suffered a power outage?

In many medium-sized companies (such as law firms, consultancies, or medical centers), all operations depend on a physical machine installed in an office room. That is where accounting software, medical records, and legal files reside. If that machine fails, the hard drive breaks, or there is an electrical storm, your 30 or 50 employees are left twiddling their thumbs. Furthermore, this model prevents fluid remote work, forcing the use of rudimentary remote connections that are slow and tremendously vulnerable to cyberattacks (Ransomware).

The trap of Buying a More Expensive Physical Server

When the equipment fails, the traditional IT maintenance company always recommends buying an even more expensive and powerful physical server for the office. Spending thousands of dollars on another metal box vulnerable to floods, thefts, or power outages is stumbling over the same technological stone twice.

Our solution: Private Cloud Architecture Migration

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we free your company from the chains of physical hardware. As Cloud engineers, we move your entire local infrastructure (management programs, databases, and files) to a highly available, accessible, and secure Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) environment.

  1. Lift & Shift Migration: We clone your current server environment and upload it to the cloud maintaining the same structure, so your employees will continue using their usual programs without needing to learn new software.
  2. High-Availability Infrastructure: We host your system in redundant Cloud clusters; if a physical machine in our data center fails, another takes over in milliseconds without your clinic noticing any disconnection.
  3. Universal and Secure Remote Access: We implement encrypted tunnels and identity gateways so your lawyers or doctors can access corporate software at maximum speed from their laptops at home or in court.
  4. Automated Backups (Snapshots): We schedule immutable backups of your entire server several times a day, ensuring that an accidental deletion or a virus never destroys your clients' critical information.

The Real Impact on your SME

  • Total Business Continuity: Your company stops depending on the office's electricity or internet connection; if there is a local blackout, your team can continue working from their phones or from home.
  • Hardware Expense Elimination: You forget forever about costly physical server renewals, hard drive repairs, and electricity bills for maintenance.
  • Guaranteed Anti-Disaster Protection: The data of your patients or legal clients is shielded in data centers with military-grade security, complying one hundred percent with data protection regulations (GDPR).
